## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., "I need backups streamed directly to AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 instead of stored as GitHub Actions artifacts.")

## Proposed Solution
A description of how you envision this working (e.g. new workflow step, repository secret, or configuration flag).

## Alternative Approaches
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or links to Supabase CLI documentation.
